tool_input.description: Create embedding feature group with L2 metric

tool_input.command:
cat > .tmp_create.py <<'PY'
import warnings; warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
import json, pandas as pd, hopsworks
from hsfs.embedding import EmbeddingIndex, SimilarityFunctionType

proj = hopsworks.login()
fs = proj.get_feature_store()

emb = EmbeddingIndex()
emb.add_embedding("embedding", 16, SimilarityFunctionType.L2)

fg = fs.get_or_create_feature_group(
    name="items026442",
    version=1,
    primary_key=["item_id"],
    online_enabled=True,
    embedding_index=emb,
    description="Item embeddings for L2 vector search",
)

df = pd.read_csv("data/items.csv")
df["embedding"] = df["embedding"].apply(json.loads)
print("rows", len(df), "sample", df.iloc[0]["item_id"], len(df.iloc[0]["embedding"]))
fg.insert(df)
print("INSERTED_OK", fg.id)
PY
mkdir -p .tmp 2>/dev/null
timeout 1200 python .tmp_create.py 2>&1 | tail -40
tool_input.description: Create embedding FG and insert items via SDK
